input.focus: Mobile messaging app: phone frame, header, search field, chat list rows with avatars and unread badges, compose button; check spacing, clipping, any stray dialog trigger, and overall layout quality

result.observation: The phone frame shows a "Messages" header with subtitle "4 unread · 2 online," a purple "V" avatar, and an "Open Menu" pill button, all cleanly aligned. A search field with icon and placeholder reads clearly. Five chat rows render with consistent spacing: colored initial avatars (teal, purple, orange, red, green), bold names, message previews with emoji, right-aligned timestamps, and indigo unread badges (2, 5, 12); Priya Nair's row has no badge. "RECENT" labels the list. The Jordan Lee row ("Yesterday") is clipped at the viewport bottom; a compose button is not visible, so its presence cannot be confirmed. A blue rounded outline surrounds the frame — likely a design-mode selection annotation, not authored UI. No stray dialogs or overlapping elements observed.
